decisions.quote:
In general, our results do not provide support for significant differences between men and
women in both the taking and the giving game, but additional analyses indicate that men are more
likely than women to allocate nothing in the TG rather than in the GG. Thus, our results are partly
consistent with Chowdhury et al.’s (2017) findings.
decisions.reason: Although the main linear gender-specific framing effects did not replicate, the authors explicitly frame their overall replication results as partly consistent with Chowdhury et al. (2017) because several null baseline comparisons and additional analyses on extreme selfishness in the taking versus giving game align with the original study.
